title: Approximate Controllability of the generalized Burgers-Huxley equation in one dimension
summary: The generalized Burgers-Huxley (GBH) equation is a prototype model that describes the interplay among reaction, convection, and diffusion. In this article, we explore the controllability of this model by means of an interior control supported in an arbitrary non-empty open subset of the domain. We establish that the GBH equation is not globally approximately controllable in a given time.
